mn88:5.2: “Sir, King Pasenadi of Kosala bows with his head at your feet;
mn88:5.4: ‘Sir, if you have no urgent business, please wait a while out of sympathy.’”
mn88:8.5: “Then, Honorable Ānanda, would the Buddha engage in the sort of verbal behavior …
mn88:8.6: mental behavior that is faulted by ascetics and brahmins?”
mn88:8.7: “No, Great King, the Buddha would not engage in the sort of mental behavior that is faulted by sensible ascetics and brahmins.”
mn88:11.4: “But what kind of mental behavior is unskillful?”
mn88:11.6: “But what kind of mental behavior is blameworthy?”
mn88:12.1: “But what kind of mental behavior is hurtful?”
mn88:12.3: “But what kind of mental behavior results in suffering?”
mn88:15.4: “But what kind of mental behavior is skillful?”
mn88:16.1: “But what kind of mental behavior is blameless?”
mn88:16.3: “But what kind of mental behavior is pleasing?”
mn88:16.5: “But what kind of mental behavior results in happiness?”
mn88:22.6: The Foreign Cloth is finished—the eighth.
